jobs.description:
For our client, a niche player within the metal sector, we are looking for a welder on the night shift.

Duties:

- welding aluminum frames and structures using TIG welding.

- performing pre-assembly in preparation of welding work

- processing production orders via PC in the ERP system (Navision)

You have experience in tig welding, through work or training

You can work in the regular night shift

You speak, understand and read English well

You have an eye for quality, order and tidiness.

You are a team player with a positive attitude

You can work with a PC

Are you an experienced roller operator with a passion for asphalt works?

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced roller operator for our asphalt works.

What does your job involve?

  • You independently operate the road roller during asphalt works.
  • You ensure the correct and even compaction of the asphalt according to the required quality standards.
  • You take into account the temperature and composition of the asphalt and adapt your working method accordingly.
  • You work closely with machine operators, drivers and other colleagues in the asphalt crew.
  • You help monitor the quality of the road surface and ensure that the works are carried out accurately.
  • You work with modern machines, techniques and tools.
  • You carry out daily checks and help ensure the proper maintenance of the machine.
  • You depart daily from the depot in Oostende.
What do we expect from you?

  • You have experience as a road roller operator, preferably in asphalt or road construction.
  • You have a good understanding of asphalt compaction and understand the importance of using the correct rolling technique.
  • You have good technical insight and can work confidently with modern machinery.
  • You are flexible and have no problem working in different weather conditions.
  • You speak fluent Dutch or English.
  • You are able to get to our depot in Oostende independently every day.

Are you technically inclined and eager to work in a dynamic production environment where you can continuously develop yourself? Then this position as an assembly worker in a 2-shift system might be something for you!

Your role

As an assembly worker, you play an important role in the production process of seating solutions, such as chairs for, among others, De Lijn. You will start with an intensive training program where you will get familiar with various assembly techniques. This way, you build the knowledge and skills to grow into a true specialist.

Responsibilities

Assembling parts for car seats according to technical instructions

Covering cushions with fabric or leather

Performing visual quality checks on finished products

Identifying and reporting errors or deviations
- Vaardigheden:

You have technical insight, from your school background, previous work experiences, or from a technical hobby. 

You can handle the heat well, as you'll be working in a warm environment.

You're eager to learn and ready to get your hands dirty.

- Attesten:

/

- Opleidingsvereisten:

A technical education is a plus, but not required.

- Vakkennis:

You have some initial experience in assembly.

- Talenkennis:

You have a good knowledge of Dutch or a good knowledge of English. Either one is enough!

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team
• Hands-on work with real responsibility
• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market
• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow
Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.
• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but if you’re motivated and hands-on, we’ll get you up to speed.
• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

Looking for a new challenge in supply chain within an international and forward-thinking organization?

As a Supply Chain Assistant you will support the supply chain team with daily tasks such as:

• Manage material availability and inventory levels to ensure uninterrupted operations. 
• Maintain SAP MRP parameters and follow up on shortages, replenishmen, and planning activities. 
• Coordinate with Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering and Operations teams to resolve material-related issues. 
• Analyze KPIs and SAP reports to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
• Support process improvement and optimization initiatives for critical materials and supply chain workflows.

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Good knowledge of SAP, MRP planning and inventory management processes.
• Strong Excel and data analysis skills.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills with a proactive and results-oriented mindset.

We are looking for packing employees who are available to work in a three-shift system (food industry) in Dendermonde?

If you're interested, read the job description and apply!

You will be working in the packing department of a company that specializes in packaging frozen products. This role involves working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 10°C).

Your main tasks include:

• Checking product quality

• Packing various products (such as fish, snacks, vegetables, etc.) into boxes or bags

• Applying labels

• Stacking boxes on pallets

• Maintaining close communication with the operator

• Other related tasks

What we expect from you:

• You have previous experience in a production environment or are willing to learn, and you can work flexibly in a three-shift system (morning, late and night shift).

• You are comfortable performing physical work at a steady pace.

• You have a good command of Dutch or English to understand safety instructions.

• You can travel independently to Dendermonde each day, as the company is located in an industrial zone and is not accessible by public transport.

• You are looking for long-term employment and are willing to complete a 2-hour packing test after a successful interview.

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

Plouvier Group is looking for a Safety Advisor to join our team.
 

With 
20 vessels and 165 colleagues, Plouvier operates a modern inland tanker fleet across Europe. We are looking for an experienced QHES professional with a strong background in 
ADN, dangerous goods and inland tanker operations.
 

As 
ADN Safety Advisor, you will play an important role in maintaining regulatory compliance and continuously improving QHES standards across our fleet.
 

Your role
 

You will be responsible for ensuring that our vessels, procedures and documentation remain compliant with 
ADN and applicable inland shipping regulations.
 

Your key responsibilities include:
 
 

• Ensuring 
ADN compliance across the fleet. 

• Acting as 
ADN Safety Advisor and providing practical guidance to vessel crews. 

• Monitoring regulatory developments and translating them into clear procedures. 

• Conducting and reviewing 
risk assessments, work permits and safety procedures. 

• Supporting incident and near-miss investigations and corrective actions. 

• Maintaining accurate and traceable 
QHES and ADN documentation. 

• Working with Captains, crew and Superintendents through 
focus groups to identify risks and improve procedures. 

• Supporting 
SIRE/VIQ, BIQ, TMSA, OCIMF and ADN audits and inspections.  

 

Your profile
 

We are looking for someone who combines strong 
ADN knowledge with practical experience in the maritime or inland shipping sector.
 

You have:
 
 

• A valid 
ADN Safety Advisor certificate. 

• Practical experience with 
ADN and dangerous goods. 

• Experience in 
inland tanker shipping is highly valued. 

• Knowledge of QHES, HSE and 
Safety Management Systems (SMS). 

• Experience with risk assessments, incident investigations and audits. 

• Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills. 

• The ability to turn regulations into practical solutions for vessel crews. 

• Fluent English, German and Dutch 

• A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience. 

• Experience with SIRE/VIQ, TMSA or OCIMF is an advantage.

• Harvesting flowers

• Cleaning up the fields, removing leftover materials and carrying out minor maintenance tasks

• All other practical tasks needed to keep the horticultural production running smoothly

• Outdoor and physically demanding work as part of your daily routine

• You are physically fit and have no problem bending, lifting or working in different weather conditions

• You are reliable, punctual and motivated

• You enjoy working hard in a dynamic environment

• You can communicate in Dutch, French or English

• You are flexible and potentially available to work weekends

Working hours:

Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

Occasional Saturdays, depending on workload or weather conditions

All overtime hours are paid

The Logistics Centre in Grimbergen is recognized as one of the world's leading facilities, reflecting the company's commitment to excellence across all operations.

Jobomschrijving

For the maintenance department of our client located in Grimbergen, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work rotating shifts (6:00-14:00 and 14:00-22:00).

This role requires strong technical knowledge, hands-on problem-solving skills, and a commitment to safety. You will troubleshoot mechanical and electrical issues, perform preventive maintenance, and respond promptly to repair requests.

Your main responsibilities as a Maintenance Technician:

• Maintain and repair automated systems as needed
• Perform maintenance and repairs on lift trucks
• Conduct electrical and mechanical maintenance on all equipment and installations
• Service and maintain order pickers, reach trucks, and combi trucks

The Maintenance Technician we are looking for possesses the following qualities:

• Engineering background
• Ability to work rotating shifts (6h-14h and 14h-22h)
• Hands-on and dynamic approach
• Precision and results-oriented mindset
• Takes initiative and assumes responsibility
• Team player who can also work independently
• Preferably experienced in welding
• Fluent in English; Dutch is a plus

jobs.occupation: Multilingual Customer Advisor – DE/EN/(NL or FR) in Liège
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about delivering outstanding customer service and fluent in multiple languages? As a Customer Advisor in our Liège-based team, you’ll be the first point of contact for customers, ensuring their needs are met with professionalism and efficiency. You’ll interact with international clients through various channels – calls, emails, and chat – providing accurate, friendly, and timely support.

You will support Satellic customers through different communication channels and provide professional, efficient assistance regarding their requests and issues: handling calls, emails, and chats related to the road toll for freight vehicles in Belgium and, in the future, other projects such as Monizze, Arrive, Fain and verification of on-board documents via the CRM system.

Ready to take the next step in your career? If you have strong language skills, a commitment to delivering excellent service, and thrive in a fast-paced, multicultural environment, we want to hear from you. Apply today and become a valued member of our international customer service team in Liège!

• Excellent command of English, both spoken and written

• Successful completion of an English language assessment

• Strong communication and customer service skills

• Good computer literacy and ability to learn new systems

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, multicultural environment

• Fluency in one or more of the following language combinations: Dutch + English, German + English, German + English + French, or German + English + Dutch

• Trilingual candidates are highly valued

• Additional language skills may qualify for a language bonus

• Upper secondary education completed

• 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in customer service or a related field

• Availability for rotating shifts between 07:00 and 22:00 (potential for homeworking)

• Full-time availability

For a logistics company in Lokeren, we are looking for packing employees who can work in a day shift.

You are responsible for the correct handling and shipment of incoming goods.

You will follow a pick list to pack and sort the goods according to their destination.

 
•

• 
You are available to work from 08:00 to 16:15.

 
• 
Physical work is no issue for you.

 
•

•

Our client, an international company operating in the manufacturing sector, is looking for a Customer Service Representative to join its customer-facing team.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will be responsible for managing customer orders from A to Z, ensuring an excellent customer experience, and acting as the key point of contact between customers and internal departments. You will work closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Production teams to guarantee smooth order processing and timely deliveries.Key Responsibilities

• Manage customer orders throughout the entire order-to-cash process.
• Enter and follow up on orders in the ERP system.
• Serve as the primary contact for customer enquiries regarding orders, deliveries, and product availability.
• Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure efficient order fulfillment.
• Monitor delivery schedules and proactively communicate any changes or delays.
• Resolve customer issues and identify appropriate solutions.
• Maintain accurate customer records and administrative documentation.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives related to customer service processes.
• Build and maintain strong long-term customer relationships.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Previous experience in Customer Service, Order Management, Sales Support, or a similar administrative position.
• Strong communication skills and customer-oriented mindset.
• Fluent in Dutch and English. French is considered an asset.
• Experience working with ERP systems (SAP knowledge is a plus).
• Good command of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

Personal Skills

• Proactive and solution-oriented.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Team player with a collaborative mindset.
• Resilient and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Customer-focused with excellent relationship-building skills.

As a Talent & Business Consultant, you will play a key role in connecting top technology professionals with leading businesses across Belgium.

Operating at the intersection of people and business, you will act as a trusted advisor to both clients and candidates while building your own network and market expertise.

 

Client Details

Our client is a leading international consultancy specialized in Technology and Digital Transformation recruitment. They partner with innovative startups, scale-ups, and global organizations to help them attract the talent shaping tomorrow's digital world.

Driven by entrepreneurship, excellence, and collaboration, they empower their consultants to build strong market expertise, develop meaningful business relationships, and make a lasting impact on companies and professionals alike.

 

Description

Develop your client portfolio

• Build and maintain relationships with technology leaders and hiring managers.
• Identify new business opportunities and expand existing partnerships.
• Understand clients' growth plans, challenges, and recruitment needs.
• Advise clients on talent market trends and hiring strategies.

Connect with top talent

• Identify, attract, and engage highly skilled professionals.
• Conduct in-depth interviews to understand candidates' ambitions and motivations.
• Guide candidates throughout the recruitment process.
• Support professionals in making important career decisions.

Drive successful recruitment projects

• Manage recruitment assignments from A to Z.
• Match talent with business needs.
• Negotiate offers and facilitate successful placements.
• Build long-term relationships with both clients and candidates.

 

You don't necessarily need recruitment experience to succeed.

We are looking for individuals who:

• Speak English with at least a native level in French OR Dutch.
• Are passionate about building relationships.
• Have a strong commercial mindset.
• Enjoy working towards ambitious goals.
• Are naturally curious and eager to learn about businesses and industries.
• Thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
• Possess excellent communication and influencing skills.
• Are resilient, proactive, and results-oriented.
Experience in sales, consulting, business development, customer success, hospitality, banking, or recruitment is considered a plus.
